name: Stonewatch
summary: Blackrock orcs hold Stonewatch above the approaches from the Burning Steppes, threatening Lakeshire. The fortress once guarded Redridge against northern invasions.

sections.title: A Bastion Overrun
sections.body: Stonewatch overlooks the cliffs near Stonewatch Falls, where its tower and keep guard the approaches from the Burning Steppes. Lakeshire's defenders first held the fortress. Then Morganth, a rogue warlock, allied with the Blackrock clan. Dark magic helped the orcs overwhelm the 12th Sabre Regiment and seize the keep. Morganth later turned against his allies and withdrew to the nearby Tower of Ilgalar with an army of Shadowhide gnolls. The Blackrock orcs kept their hold under Warlord Gath'Ilzogg and Lieutenant Tharil'zun.

sections.title: The Threat to Lakeshire
sections.body: Blackrock orcs hold Stonewatch, leaving Lakeshire exposed to conquest. Stormwind's House of Nobles has provided no substantial military reinforcements, whether through indifference or paralysis. Magistrate Solomon and Marshal Marris have had to hire mercenaries and call for volunteers. Their best hope of lifting the threat over the region is to strike at the fortress's leaders, Tharil'zun and Gath'Ilzogg.

faq.answer: The Blackrock clan holds Stonewatch under Warlord Gath'Ilzogg and his lieutenant, Tharil'zun. They drove out the kingdom's garrison and use the stronghold to stage attacks across Redridge.

faq.q: How did the humans lose Stonewatch?
faq.answer: Blackrock orcs, aided by the dark sorcery of the rogue human warlock Morganth, invaded and overwhelmed the 12th Sabre Regiment. The defenders fell, and the orcs took the fortress.

faq.q: Why isn't Stormwind sending an army to take it back?
faq.answer: Stormwind has not sent enough troops to the border regions, leaving Magistrate Solomon and Marshal Marris to defend Redridge. Lakeshire depends on visiting adventurers and mercenaries for counterattacks against Stonewatch.

faq.q: What is the relationship between Stonewatch and the Tower of Ilgalar?
faq.answer: Morganth helped the Blackrock orcs seize Stonewatch, then betrayed them soon after their victory. He built the nearby Tower of Ilgalar and gathered magical thralls and Shadowhide gnolls there, attacking both orcs and humans.

angles.text: For the Alliance, Stonewatch is one of the most dangerous hostile orc positions inside Alliance lands. Taking it back is vital to Redridge's safety.
As a human, the slaughter of the 12th Sabre Regiment and the fall of Stonewatch show how vulnerable Lakeshire is and how little help Stormwind's leaders have given it.
